acceptance: Baseline schema, checker and make sqlglot-repro-retirement-check support wrapper cases; malformed or missing cases still fail closed, with tests.
A unit test shows a wrapper output change fails the checker while the direct-transpile check still passes.
The mysql workaround path in the baseline points at the real code.
make pr-preflight, make comment-policy-check and make typecheck pass; PR merged.
description: scripts/check_sqlglot_repro_retirement.py calls the vendored transpile directly, so wrapper output can change while the check passes. Add an 'entry' field (transpile or wrapper) plus platform and optional ddl_options to baseline cases. Wrapper cases call translate_sql_query / translate_ddl / apply_rewrite and must execute on the named engine and match expected rows. Fix the mysql-percentile-decorator workaround path (the baseline names dialect_compat.py, which has no percentile logic). Keep the README rule that retirement needs both read=<target> and read=postgres probes to pass with the helper removed.
